payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics and methodologies used to evaluate the experiment, including the hits@k metric and cosine similarity for ranking hotels.

claims.text: The experiment was evaluated using the hits@k metric, which measures the average number of times the correct selection appears in the top k predictions.
Cosine similarity of embedding vectors was used to rank hotels, providing an alternative evaluation method when model probabilities are not feasible.
A/B testing was employed to compare the performance of enriched embeddings against session-only embeddings.
The average similarity between hotels in the same market was calculated to evaluate how well market-level information was encoded in the embeddings.
